surface_value: Acetaminophen causes liver damage by overwhelming the glutathione pathway with its metabolite, NAPQI. Cocaine effects on the liver include rhabdomyolysis (leakage of muscle contents into blood circulation). Methamphetamine liver damage is usually the result of hyperthermia or abnormally high body temperature.
